goal: Allow users and external tools to set manual block prune locks via RPC and startup options
Prevent pruned nodes from deleting blocks needed for future wallet rescans or external indexers
agreement: Broad support with substantive review and testing (achow101, stickies-v, optout21)
Verified by testing with an electrs indexer backed by a pruned signet node (optout21)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, andrewtoth)
Open suggestions on startup options and tip semantics await author response (andrewtoth, optout21)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fills a missing capability for downstream wallets and indexers on pruned nodes
Enables external applications to prevent pruning of needed blocks without disabling pruning entirely
